technical.summary: AMGN shows strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and long-term MA alignment, but overbought RSI conditions across all periods and negative CMF/OBV momentum divergence limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: AMGN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying data, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 9 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; congressional activity is mixed and dated with only small purchases from non-senior members; lack of recent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (404.96), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 9 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for AMGN.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX strong trend confirmation + EMA 50/200 bullish alignment + Ichimoku above cloud provide structural uptrend support, with extreme market fear (28/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity near support level 222.83.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI across all periods, negative CMF/OBV momentum divergence, MACD bearish crossover, earnings volatility in 9 days, crisis VIX environment, and zero fundamental conviction (insider/institutional/government signals absent) create excessive risk-to-reward imbalance for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While ADX trend structure and Ichimoku alignment offer technical support, overbought RSI conditions combined with negative momentum divergence (CMF/OBV) and MACD bearish crossover create poor risk-to-reward at current levels.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 9 days combined with crisis VIX environment (404.96) and zero fundamental conviction (no insider/institutional accumulation) creates asymmetric downside risk in already overbought conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, risk, and debate agents all converge on bear case; sentiment contrarian signal insufficient to override structural weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Existing AMGN position plus 64 open Health Care positions (19% of portfolio) create sector concentration risk; earnings proximity argues for position reduction, not addition.
